---
title: "Sprott O System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y\\
\dot{y} &=& -x+z\\
\dot{z} &=& x+xz+ay
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.3$ and initial condition $(-2,0,-1)$.
